_documentation.purpose: Local plugin-level override for GlbBuilder runtime settings. Keys present here override the matching defaults from GlbBuilderConfig inside Na__DataLib__CoreIndex__Tags__.json (the GitHub-shared SSOT). Keys absent here fall through to the DataLib default. Only the Logging sub-object is read at present.
_documentation.usage: To enable verbose Ruby Console logging during a debug session, set ConsoleVerbose to true and reload the plugin. Set it back to false when finished. Do NOT commit this file with ConsoleVerbose: true as it causes significant export slow-down.
